SEGMENT INFORMATION The following table presents net sales by business segment and business segment operating profit (loss), which is the Company's measure of segment profitability. Business segment operating profit (loss) is a measure reported to our management for purposes of making decisions about allocating resources to our business segments and assessing the performance of our business segments. Third quarter 2026 net sales by business segment and business segment operating profit (loss) compared with the second quarter of 2026 and the third quarter of 2025 are as follows: Business Segment Results (In millions) Third Quarter 2026 Third Quarter 2025 Second Quarter 2026 Net Sales by Business Segment Packaging Solutions North America $ 3,880 $ 3,898 $ 3,688 Packaging Solutions EMEA 2,280 2,310 2,287 Corporate and Inter-segment Sales 37 14 29 Net Sales $ 6,197 $ 6,222 $ 6,004 Business Segment Operating Profit (Loss) Packaging Solutions North America $ 427 $ (166) $ 204 Packaging Solutions EMEA (73) (58) (80) Packaging Solutions North America (PS NA) business segment operating profit (loss) in the third quarter of 2026 was $427 million compared with $204 million in the second quarter of 2026. In the third quarter of 2026, net sales increased reflecting higher sales prices partially offset by lower sales volumes driven by a softer demand environment. Cost of products sold decreased driven by lower planned maintenance outage costs and lower sales volumes, partially offset by higher input costs for recovered fiber, energy and fuel. Improved mill performance drove lower operating costs including the non-repeat of the Riverdale paper machine conversion. This was partially offset by the impact of suspended operations at Pine Hill. Depreciation and amortization expense increased due to two additional months of depreciation expense in the third quarter
